claims: Spring break 2026 in the USA primarily centers around the weeks of March 16–20 and March 23–27.
Peak travel and crowded conditions are expected between March 15 and March 23 for Spring break 2026 in the USA.
Peak dates for 2026 Spring Break are March 15–March 23, 2026.
Early breaks of March 8–16 are common for some colleges.
Late breaks of March 22–30 are common for some colleges.
Miami-Dade and Palm Beach school districts' 2026 Spring break is March 23–27.
Hillsborough County (FL) school district's 2026 Spring break is March 16–20.
Harris County (TX - Houston area) school district's 2026 Spring break is March 16–20.
UT Austin's 2026 Spring break is March 16–21.
University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign's 2026 Spring break is March 16–20.
